// description: Typecheck scope for infra/ + sst.config.ts. These files live at the repo root (not inside a workspace), so Turbo's per-package typecheck step would not cover them. Without this config, infra bugs only surface at `sst deploy` time. `bun run typecheck` chains this file after the Turbo run.
// globals: SST's shipped type surface (`.sst/platform/config.d.ts`) transitively imports `.sst/platform/src/components/**`, whose internal source has TS2345 errors against modern @types/node (`Buffer<ArrayBufferLike>` vs `BinaryLike`). We can't typecheck that cleanly today. Instead we use our own ambient shim at `infra/_sst-globals.d.ts` — picked up automatically via `include`. Trade-off + trigger to replace it: see the shim's header.
// deploy-time-guard: The shim types `sst.aws.<Component>` as `any`, so typos like `sst.aws.KmsKey` (doesn't exist) are NOT caught here. Run `bun sst diff --stage <your-dev>` before pushing an infra change — see `CLAUDE.md` §Workflow.
